overview: Composite scoring system using weighted multi-criteria analysis

pollution_density.description: Current pollution level based on plastic weight

trend_increase.calculation: Based on forecast trend direction and magnitude

environmental_impact.description: Ecological impact based on depth and location
environmental_impact.calculation: Combination of depth and biodiversity factors

plastic_type_risk.description: Environmental risk based on plastic type
plastic_type_risk.calculation: Risk scores based on persistence and toxicity

accessibility.description: Ease of cleanup based on depth and location

final_score: Weighted sum of all components, normalized to 0-100 scale
